semantics.representation: base-10 coefficient plus signed scale, resource-bounded
semantics.arithmetic: addition, subtraction and multiplication are exact unless an explicit context is supplied
semantics.division_without_context: only exact terminating decimal quotients are admitted; nonterminating results report NONTERMINATING_REQUIRES_CONTEXT
semantics.context: precision and rounding mode are explicit immutable values passed to the operation; there is no mutable process-global decimal context
semantics.equality: numeric equality ignores representational trailing-zero scale; formatting/serialization may preserve or canonicalize scale only through an explicitly selected policy
semantics.float_mixing: Decimal and binary floating point never mix implicitly
semantics.to_f64_exact: reject unless the Decimal numeric value is exactly representable as finite binary64
semantics.to_f64_nearest: explicit round-to-nearest-ties-to-even conversion; reject overflow to infinity unless a separate infinity-producing API is selected
semantics.resource_policy: precision, absolute scale, parsed input length, output allocation and work are bounded; arbitrary precision is outside hard-RT unless memory and WCET are statically bounded
